data.title: Why Koreans ask what year you were born
data.author: bryanhogan
data.article_summary: 在韩国，年龄非常重要，人们常在初次见面时询问出生年份。这是因为韩国文化中存在严格的等级制度，年龄决定相互间的尊重和礼仪。例如，"친구"（朋友）仅用于同龄人之间，且在语言中有七种不同的敬语层次，反映对话双方的年龄差异。年长者对年幼者用较为随意的语气，而年幼者需使用敬语。韩国还有两种年龄计算方式：国际年龄和韩国年龄。韩国年龄在出生时即为一岁，每逢元旦加一岁，因此通常比国际年龄大一两岁。虽然韩国正逐渐采用国际年龄，但韩国年龄在社会中仍具影响力，比如法定饮酒年龄以韩国年龄计。因此，询问出生年份是为了避免年龄换算的混淆。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同文化中的称谓、敬语和社会等级制度

不同观点：
• **巴西的敬语使用存在地域差异**：[dkga] 提到在巴西，敬语使用有很强的地域变化。例如，"você" 和 "tu" 都是非正式的 "你"，但在不同地区使用频率不同。在乡村地区，人们常用 "Doutor/Doutora" 来称呼受过教育的人或地主。此外，有些人认为使用非正式语言是尊重的表现，而有些人则认为对长辈或上司使用敬语是必要的尊重。

• **法国对名字使用的文化差异**：[bambax] 提到在法国，直接用名字称呼陌生人或在邮件中使用名字让人不适，尤其是年长者更注重这种礼节。名字的使用在法国文化中具有特殊意义。

• **美国非正式称谓的局限性**：[xenadu02] 指出在美国，员工直呼CEO名字或用过于随意的方式称呼可能会引起负面反应，反之亦然。每种语言都有表达尊敬、亲密和荣誉的明确或隐含规则，即使在非正式系统中也是如此。

• **韩国年龄系统的复杂性**：[GreyMolecules] 提到韩国年龄系统中 "빠른" 概念，即1-2月出生的人可能与前一年出生的人一起入学并社交，这种微妙的年龄识别影响了社会关系。

• **韩国社会等级的应对策略**：[Leftium] 提到一些韩国职场使用英文名或昵称来避免社会等级制度的约束。这种做法在舞伴俱乐部中也很常见，帮助人们规避语言中的等级要求。

• **日本社会系统的复杂性**：[bitbasher] 分享了自己在日本经历的社交边界问题，尤其是在与长辈互动时，需要遵循一定的社交礼仪，而不是主动建议或行动。

• **韩国年龄等级对航空安全的影响**：[socalgal2] 提到高权力距离文化在20世纪80-90年代导致了一些航空事故，因为副驾驶不敢质疑机长的决定。

• **因年龄差异导致的关系问题**：[unstppbl] 提到与一位韩国同学因年龄差异而无法继续恋爱关系，尽管彼此有好感。

• **韩国社会中敬语使用不当的冲突**：[kinleyd] 分享了自己在韩国因不了解敬语规则而引发冲突的经历，强调了年龄和敬语在韩国社会中的重要性。

• **韩国敬语与心理距离**：[Leftium] 引用书籍解释了韩国敬语不仅表示礼貌，还反映了说话者之间的心理距离。在亲密关系中使用敬语可能表明关系的疏远。

• **韩国废除年龄计算系统的影响**：[gnabgib] 提到韩国废除传统年龄计算系统后带来的变化，以及这种系统在社会中的作用。

• **对等级制度的批判**：[whensean] 认为这种基于等级的文化虽然增加了礼貌，但更多地导致了年龄霸凌和对创新的阻碍，并认为中国受儒家文化影响较小，没有如此复杂的礼节系统。

补充讨论：
• **印度年龄计算方式的差异**：[OJFord] 提到在印度，年龄计算是以1为基础，而不是以0为基础，这种差异在跨文化交流中可能引发误解和趣味。

争议焦点：
• 是否应强制遵守社会等级制度和敬语规则，尤其是在这些规则可能抑制个人表达和创新时。

44244879.article_content:
One thing that was surprising for me in South Korea was how important age is.
Meeting new people in Korea they would often ask very early on what year I was born. But why? In Germany, people generally don’t really care that much about your age. In Korea there are several reasons why age matters though.
Showing Respect & You
You can’t be “friends” if you are not born in the same year. At least, the word “친구 / chingu” which translates to “friend” is only used between people born in the same year. You can still be friends with anyone regardless of what your age is, but there is a tendency to be with people born in the same year as you for multiple reasons.
In Korean culture age matters, you should always show respect to your elders and any people older than you.
There is a more strict hierarchy which is purely decided by age.
This is also heavily rooted into the language. There are 7 different speech levels, although only 6 are actually used. They are all used to show different levels of respect depending on which formality and politeness would be adequate towards the listener.
So the older person usually talks “down” to the younger person, and the younger person has to talk “up” to show the older person more respect.
The younger person also addresses the older person, usually with a title or another word that fits their relationship, but not their name. Only the older person addresses the younger one with their name. (
There can be more nuance.
)
Using “you” in Korean is quite interesting since the direct translation 너 / neo is often too rude. Instead you can:
Just don’t, omit the “you”
Use titles instead (“선생님 / seonsaengnim” for teacher, “사장님 / sajangnim” for manager)
Use “언니 / Unnie” , “오빠 / Oppa”, “누나 / Noona” or “형 / Hyung” (for an older friend)
“그쪽 / geujjok” (stranger momentarily, can be rude, avoided by many)
Name + 씨 / ssi
당신 / dangsin (spouse, songs, speeches)
너 / neo (it’s highly impolite, good for starting fights, okay for close friends)
So one of the main reasons why age matters in Korea is to understand the relation between the two of you.
The Different Ages
But why ask for the year born and not age?
Well, Koreans might still ask how old and if you then answer with an amount of years that might lead to confusion. “Which one?” could be a possible reaction to your answer.
Which one? In Korea you will find that people use two different kinds of counting systems for age, the international age and the Korean age.
The international age is what I was used to, but what is Korean age?
In Korean age you are born with 1 and you gain a year on January 1st. Yes, every person gains a year at the beginning of the calendar year. This means that your Korean age is always one or two years more than your international age.
This can lead to the funny situation of someone who’s born on December 31st being two years old the next day in Korean age after not even spending one whole day on this earth.
South Korea is shifting over to use international age more and more, they even formally adopted to the international age standard in June 2023. But Korean age is still deeply ingrained into society and still relevant. For example, the legal drinking age in Korea is 20 in Korean age.
So one solution to make things easier in a conversation, is to just ask for the birth year instead.
I want to hear your feedback! Was something confusing? Did you get stuck? Did you find this post amazingly helpful? Was it all very mid? Let me know per
e-mail
or at any of my social media spaces!

• **韩国废除年龄计算系统的影响**：[gnabgib] 提到韩国废除传统年龄计算系统后带来的变化，以及这种系统在社会中的作用。

• **对等级制度的批判**：[whensean] 认为这种基于等级的文化虽然增加了礼貌，但更多地导致了年龄霸凌和对创新的阻碍，并认为中国受儒家文化影响较小，没有如此复杂的礼节系统。

补充讨论：
• **印度年龄计算方式的差异**：[OJFord] 提到在印度，年龄计算是以1为基础，而不是以0为基础，这种差异在跨文化交流中可能引发误解和趣味。

争议焦点：
• 是否应强制遵守社会等级制度和敬语规则，尤其是在这些规则可能抑制个人表达和创新时。

data.title: Congratulations on creating the one billionth repository on GitHub
data.author: petercooper
data.article_summary: 这篇文章报道了GitHub上第一亿个代码库的创建，库名为"shit"，由用户AasishPokhrel创建。GitHub官方发文祝贺，并幽默地希望创建者能构建出一些伟大的"💩"。该帖收到了大量用户的互动反应，包括点赞、庆祝等。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：GitHub第10亿个代码库的相关话题，包括技术实现、趣味性、企业运营数据公开性以及与其他平台的对比。

不同观点：
• [Aachen] 提到 OpenStreetMap 的类似事件，认为GitHub第10亿个代码库的达成更具趣味性，因为这是一个随机的、非刻意追求的结果。他还引申讨论了不同代码托管平台上的代码库数量问题，并提出是否有人创建了跨平台的搜索引擎。
• [caleblloyd] 关注GitHub的OpenAPI规范的技术问题，指出GitHub在其他领域（如工作流运行ID）已经遇到类似数值溢出问题，并预计GitHub未来在代码库数量上也可能面临相似问题。
• [JKCalhoun] 分享了在苹果公司使用内部工具"Radar"的经历，提到类似于GitHub里程碑式的编号事件，在他们内部也曾引发特殊关注和趣味性，但遗憾未保存一些有趣的记录。
• [8organicbits] 提供了GitHub上第一个代码库的链接，将讨论焦点转向历史和具体示例，而不是技术或趣味性问题。
• [CGamesPlay] 推测第10亿个代码库是通过脚本自动创建的，并通过反复检查编号实现。他还提到了Facebook上的类似事件D666666，认为这是一种常见技术手法。
• [umanwizard] 对GitHub公开新代码库创建速率表示惊讶，认为这种信息通常应为企业机密。
• [Sohcahtoa82] 提到第10亿个代码库被重命名和重定向，表示遗憾。
• [Cyphase] 猜测该代码库可能是为了成为第10亿个而专门创建的，提出了动机问题。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户（如[lbeckman314]和[zaps]）以幽默方式回应，使用网络文化语言表达对GitHub这一里程碑的赞赏。
• 讨论中包含了一些技术链接和资源，如[Aachen]和[caleblloyd]提供的相关博客和问题链接，为感兴趣的读者提供了深入了解的途径。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于第10亿个代码库是否是自然达成还是刻意为之，[CGamesPlay]和[Cyphase]对此有不同推测。
• 另一个争议点是GitHub公开代码库创建速率信息是否合适，[umanwizard]对此表示质疑。

data.title: Show HN: DIY virtual HDMI monitor using "AR" glasses
data.author: blensor
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了在Orange Pi 5 Plus上使用Viture Pro XR眼镜和HDMI输入实现虚拟显示的项目。该项目通过V4L2设备捕获视频，将其转换为RGB格式，并实时显示在OpenGL窗口中的纹理平面上。项目仍处于早期开发阶段，性能有待提升。它支持Viture头戴设备的IMU集成、测试图案和平面几何。运行该项目需要基于Linux的操作系统和一些依赖库，如OpenGL、GLUT和libv4l。用户可以通过命令行选项配置设备路径、全屏模式、IMU集成、测试图案等功能。此外，文章还提到未来计划支持其他SBC和USB HDMI采集卡，并改进性能和功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AR眼镜的功能、技术细节、舒适度、分辨率以及现有解决方案的比较

不同观点：
• sitkack认为，该项目没有明确说明AR眼镜是否提供一个环境锁定虚拟屏幕（即屏幕在头部移动时保持固定）。一些AR眼镜具备此功能，但项目可以通过其他特性弥补AR眼镜的不足，或者突破厂商的产品升级限制。
• Aaron2222指出，Xreal One和One Pro眼镜本身具备该功能，且Xreal Eye摄像头增加了6DOF追踪功能，扩展了应用场景。
• stavros以实际使用体验为例，说明Xreal Air眼镜可以通过应用实现虚拟第二屏功能，但对于只需要一个屏幕的用户来说，不需要额外使用应用。
• xeonmc建议，如果只有3DOF追踪，可以使显示图像无立体视差，使其在光学上正确显示，类似于战斗机上的反射式瞄准器。
• verdverm提到Immersed.com软件提供了多重虚拟屏幕功能，并支持各大操作系统和VR设备，且即将推出自己的头戴设备。
• wkat4242抱怨Xreal Air的舒适度问题，如 prescription inlays过小、重量压鼻等问题，同时对比了Quest 3的优缺点。

补充讨论：
• LonelyWolfe对目前AR眼镜普遍使用1080p显示器表示不满，认为应提升分辨率以替代实体显示器，但厂商似乎回避了这一问题。
• skeptrune认为，以409美元的价格获得一个可供黑客开发的AR显示器是非常划算的，显示硬件开发的门槛越来越低。
• deivid质疑该项目的“重映射”功能与眼镜本身功能的区别，并询问项目是否涉及将HDMI信号转换为Viture协议。
• benhoff关注技术问题，询问是否修复了OP5Plus手机HDMI输入驱动的不稳定问题。
• amelius对Viture眼镜的瞳距设计提出质疑，认为该设计可能更适合亚洲市场，而不适合西方市场。
• unsupp0rted提出了一种特殊需求，希望AR眼镜使用电子墨水屏，以满足特定使用场景的需求。

争议焦点：
• AR眼镜是否提供环境锁定虚拟屏幕功能，sitkack认为项目描述不明确，而Aaron2222则指出某些产品已具备该功能。
• AR眼镜的分辨率问题，LonelyWolfe认为当前产品分辨率不足，且厂商未积极改进。
• Viture眼镜的瞳距设计是否适合西方市场，amelius认为设计不合适，而其他评论未提及此问题。

V4L2 Viture Virtual Display
Attention
this is
still in early development
and not fully functional yet. It will work but performance needs to be improved a lot.
v4l2_gl captures video from a HDMI-in on an OrangePI 5 Plus using the hdmirx V4L2 device, converts frames to RGB, and displays them in real-time on a textured quad in an OpenGL window. It supports Viture headset IMU integration, test patterns, and plane geometry.
Supported platforms
Orange Pi 5 Plus
To run this as intended you need an OrangePi 5 Plus with armbian ( we are using BredOS ) that has Device Tree Overlays enabled and has the hdmi-rx device tree overlay active.
Other SBCs
If you are using a Raspberry Pi or other device without HDMI-in you need a USB capture card that is supported on your Linux version
Testing without HDMI
For testing purposes you can run it on a laptop with a webcam but that does not provide you with a virtual display.
Dependencies
This requires a linux based OS and installed gcc and build tools.
To compile and run this application, ensure the following libraries are installed:
OpenGL and GLUT libraries
:
These are essential for creating the window and rendering graphics. On Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, you can install them using:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install freeglut3-dev
libv4l2 library
:
sudo apt install libv4l-dev
libhidapi-dev
(optional): If your are using the revers engineered protocol instead of the official Viture SDK
sudo apt install libhidapi-dev
Compilation
Depending on the architecture you are running it on use the reverse engineered protocol version ( ARM ) or the official Viture SDK version ( X86 )
Using the reverse engineered protocol
make
This will generate the executable
v4l2_gl
Using the official Viture SDK
make viture_sdk
This will generate the executable
v4l2_gl_viture_sdk
Running the viewer
Execute the compiled application from your terminal:
sudo ./v4l2_gl [options]
or
sudo ./v4l2_gl_viture_sdk [options]
Recenter view / rotation reset
Quickly shake your head left/right 3 times to reset the rotation to the center position after the IMU has drifted too far.
Command-Line Options
The application supports the following command-line options:
--device <path>
:
Specifies the V4L2 device path (e.g., /dev/video0).
Default:
/dev/video0
.
Example:
./v4l2_gl --device /dev/video1
--fullscreen
:
Runs the application in fullscreen mode.
Default:
false
(disabled).
Example:
./v4l2_gl --fullscreen
--viture
:
Enables integration with Viture headset IMU for controlling the rotation of the displayed plane. The Viture SDK and device must be correctly set up.
Default:
false
(disabled).
Example:
./v4l2_gl --viture
--test-pattern
:
Displays a generated test pattern on the plane instead of the live camera feed. Useful for testing rendering and transformations.
Default:
false
(disabled).
Example:
./v4l2_gl --test-pattern
--plane-distance <distance>
:
Sets the distance at which the plane orbits the world origin.
<distance>
is a floating-point value.
Default:
1.0
.
Example:
./v4l2_gl --plane-distance 0.5
--plane-scale <scale>
:
Sets a scale multiplier for the size of the plane.
<scale>
is a floating-point value (must be > 0).
Default:
1.0
(original size). Values greater than 1.0 enlarge the plane, less than 1.0 shrink it. Values <= 0.0 are reset to 1.0.
Example:
./v4l2_gl --plane-scale 1.5
Combined Example
You can combine these options:
./v4l2_gl --device /dev/video1 --viture --fullscreen --plane-distance 0.8 --plane-scale 1.2 --test-pattern
This command would:
Use V4L2 device
/dev/video1
.
Enable Viture IMU.
Run in fullscreen.
Set the plane orbit distance to 0.8 units.
Scale the plane to 120% of its original size.
Display the test pattern.

13 Jun 2025
Several explosions have been reported in and around Iran’s capital Tehran, according to the state-run news agency Nour News.
“Loud explosions are being heard in different locations of the capital Tehran,” it said in a TV report, adding that Iran’s air defence system is on full alert and all flights at Iman Khomeini airport have been suspended.

list 3 of 3
Trump warns of ‘chance of massive conflict’ amid Israel-Iran tensions
end of list
While the Israeli military is yet to release an official public statement on the attack, it has reportedly confirmed to the Times of Israel newspaper that it has “launched an aerial campaign against Iran’s nuclear programme”.
The operation, dubbed “Nation of Lions”, has seen Israeli fighter jets bomb dozens of targets related to Iran’s nuclear programme and other military facilities, the outlet reported.
The Israeli military told the outlet that Iran has enough enriched uranium to build several nuclear bombs within days and it needed to act against this “imminent threat”.
Sirens have sounded across Israel as a preemptive warning as Israeli authorities prepare for a potential Iranian response. In a post on X, the Israeli military announced that Israel’s civil and public security guidelines had been changed to “essential activity” as of 03:00 local time (00:00 GMT).

“The guidelines include: a ban on educational activities, gatherings, and workplaces, except for essential businesses,” it said.
Israel’s Transportation Ministry has confirmed that it has also closed the country’s airspace for arrivals and departures until further notice.
Two unnamed US officials confirmed to the Reuters news agency that Israel informed Washington of the attack, but it did not assist in its planning or execution.
Al Jazeera correspondent Alan Fisher said developments over recent days indicated that US President Donald Trump “was told that there was going to be some sort of strike”.
“[Just] 24 hours ago the United States announced that it was going to start moving non-essential personnel out of the embassy in Baghdad [in Iraq] and also recommended that others in embassies around the region could also leave if they wish. That seemed to suggest that there was going to be an attack of some sort,” he said.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）和ChatBot在编程中的应用及其潜在影响

不同观点：
• [colbyn] 认为LLM和ChatBot在处理常见、重复性的编程任务时，能够显著提升生产力。他个人经历过从反对到接受的转变，尤其是在处理不需要太多项目特定背景的任务时。然而，他也担心这种依赖可能导致个人解决问题的能力停滞不前，更广泛地，担心这种趋势可能导致技术生态系统中新工具和思想的停滞，因为人们可能更倾向于使用在LLM训练数据中表现良好的旧工具。

• [MongooseStudios] 表示他完全不用LLM或ChatBot，并且对不使用这些工具并不感到担忧。他更喜欢用自己的大脑解决问题并理解解决方案，暗示这些工具可能会让人放弃深度思考和学习。

• [Daishiman] 认为当前的代码补全工具（如ChatBot）与最前沿的编码模型（如Claude）的输出质量有很大差距。他建议尝试一些更高级的模型，并认为这些模型在处理特定、定义明确的繁琐任务时表现可能超出预期。

补充讨论：
• colbyn提出了对技术生态系统长期发展的担忧，特别是新工具和思想的推广可能受到阻碍。
• MongooseStudios强调个人独立思考和理解解决方案的重要性，暗示了对过度依赖自动化工具的批判。
• Daishiman则关注不同LLM工具在代码生成质量上的差异，指出了尝试更高级模型的潜在好处。

争议焦点：依赖LLM/ChatBot是否会导致个人解决问题的能力停滞不前，以及这种趋势对技术生态系统的长期影响。

data.title: Show HN: S3mini – Tiny and fast S3-compatible client, no-deps, edge-ready
data.author: neon_me
data.article_summary: **s3mini** 是一个超轻量级的 TypeScript S3 客户端，大小约 14 KB，性能比同类库高约 15%。它无依赖，支持 AWS SigV4 签名，适用于 Node.js、Bun 和 Cloudflare Workers 等边缘计算平台，但不支持浏览器环境。该库支持基本的 S3 操作，如创建、列出、获取、删除对象及多部分上传，已在 Cloudflare R2、Backblaze B2、DigitalOcean Spaces 和 MinIO 上测试。用户可以通过 npm、yarn 或 pnpm 安装，并在 Node.js 或 Cloudflare Workers 环境中使用，需配置相应的访问凭证和端点信息。

s3mini | Tiny & fast S3 client for node and edge platforms.
s3mini
is an ultra-lightweight Typescript client (~14 KB minified, ≈15 % more ops/s) for S3-compatible object storage. It runs on Node, Bun, Cloudflare Workers, and other edge platforms. It has been tested on Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, and MinIO. (No Browser support!)
[
github
]
[
issues
]
[
npm
]
Features
🚀 Light and fast: averages ≈15 % more ops/s and only ~14 KB (minified, not gzipped).
🔧 Zero dependencies; supports AWS SigV4 (no pre-signed requests).
🟠 Works on Cloudflare Workers; ideal for edge computing, Node, and Bun (no browser support).
🔑 Only the essential S3 APIs—improved list, put, get, delete, and a few more.
📦
BYOS3
—
Bring your own S3-compatible bucket
(tested on Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO and Garage! Ceph and AWS are in the queue).
Tested On
Dev:
Performance tests was done on local Minio instance. Your results may vary depending on environment and network conditions, so take it with a grain of salt.
Table of Contents
Supported Ops
Installation
Usage
Security Notes
💙 Contributions welcomed!
License
Supported Ops
The library supports a subset of S3 operations, focusing on essential features, making it suitable for environments with limited resources.
Bucket ops
✅ HeadBucket (bucketExists)
✅ createBucket (createBucket)
Objects ops
✅ ListObjectsV2 (listObjects)
✅ GetObject (getObject, getObjectResponse, getObjectWithETag, getObjectRaw, getObjectArrayBuffer, getObjectJSON)
✅ PutObject (putObject)
✅ DeleteObject (deleteObject)
✅ HeadObject (objectExists, getEtag, getContentLength)
✅ listMultipartUploads
✅ CreateMultipartUpload (getMultipartUploadId)
✅ completeMultipartUpload
✅ abortMultipartUpload
✅ uploadPart
❌ CopyObject: Not implemented (tbd)

npm install s3mini
yarn add s3mini
pnpm add s3mini

• linotype希望有一个简单的、单二进制文件的S3服务器替代Minio，并建议加入类似DuckDB UI的界面。

• dev_l1x_be讨论了在Node.js环境中使用Rust S3库的经验，强调了支持特定功能（如异步、HTTP2等）会导致项目变得复杂。
• cosmotic对某个性能测试结果感到困惑，不理解为何实例速度越快，操作速度反而变慢。
• tommoor对该项目在未确认是否与AWS兼容的情况下就发布表示质疑。
• nodesocket提到s5cmd这个专注于性能的S3工具，声称其上传/下载速度比其他工具快得多。
• brendanashworth询问该工具与obstore的比较。
• _1提问该工具是否与Minio类似。
• shortformblog分享了自己使用S3替代工具的经历，指出AWS可能会阻止非官方客户端，因此像这样的兼容客户端有其必要性。
• busymom0关心是否可以生成带有大小限制和名称检查的签名上传URL。
• dzonga对边缘计算与传统VPS的价格进行了比较，提出了成本效益的问题。
• EGreg建议开发一个基于FUSE的工具，像goofys一样将文件夹映射到S3桶，并提出进一步的改进建议。
• hsbauauvhabzb认为该工具的描述不够清晰，建议在README中更早说明其解决的问题。

• 多个评论关注工具的性能和使用场景，包括与Minio、s5cmd、obstore等类似工具的比较。
• 签名URL和与AWS兼容性是用户关心的重要问题。
• 部分评论对工具的应用场景和文档描述提出了改进建议。

data.title: Apple announces Foundation Models and Containerization frameworks, etc
data.author: thm
data.article_summary: 苹果公司宣布了一系列新的开发者工具和技术，旨在帮助开发者在其平台上创建更美观、智能和互动的应用程序。主要更新包括设备上的智能模型（Apple Intelligence），以及Xcode 26中集成的大型语言模型（如ChatGPT），使开发者能够更快速、自信地构建现代应用。新的软件设计采用了名为“Liquid Glass”的材料，增强了应用的表达力和用户体验。同时，Foundation Models框架允许开发者利用设备上的智能功能，支持Swift，并注重用户隐私。此外，新的Icon Composer应用帮助开发者设计视觉上更具吸引力的应用图标。这些工具和技术的增强旨在支持开发者创造更丰富的用户体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Apple 在 WWDC 上发布的新技术和工具，包括 Xcode 26 中的生成语言模型、容器化框架、以及其他开发者体验改进。

不同观点：
• **[对生成语言模型和 AI 工具的积极评价]** [gdubs] 认为新的 Foundation 框架和生成语言模型对于 Apple 开发者来说是一个重要的改进，尤其是本地运行和设备上的处理能力。结合旅行应用的示例展示了其潜力，且 vibe-coding 集成让开发者可以轻松回滚代码改动和获得上下文感知，整体提升了开发体验。不过，这些功能并非完全创新，但 Apple 在用户体验上做得很好。
   
• **[对容器化框架的期望与失望]** [pxc] 原本希望 Apple 推出 macOS 原生容器化支持，但发现此次的容器化框架并未实现这一期望，只是对现有工具如 OrbStack 的“Sherlock 化”。[dedicate] 则认为容器化框架可能是巨大的改进，可以改变开发者工作流，甚至减少 Docker 的麻烦。

• **[对 AI 模型适用范围的担忧]** [pzo] 指出 Apple 的 AI 模型仅支持 iPhone 15 Pro 和 iPhone 16 系列，覆盖率仅为 25% 的 iOS 设备。对于第三方开发者来说，这限制了这些模型的实用性，除非未来更多设备支持，否则开发者可能不会优先使用这些模型。

• **[对容器化框架技术细节的讨论]** [badc0ffee] 提到容器化框架的视频已经发布，每个容器将在自己的虚拟机中运行，使用 Swift 编写的轻量级 init。目前尚无关于 Linux 内核或是否支持 ARM/Intel 的详细信息。[sammysheep] 则担心静态链接 musl 可能导致性能问题，并引用了相关技术文章讨论。

• **[对 UI 设计和系统功能的讨论]** [guybedo] 总结了多个要点，包括 Apple 的 AI 模型主要在设备上运行，新的容器化框架基于虚拟机而非原生内核集成，Spotlight 搜索功能被广泛认为缓慢且不可靠。此外，iPadOS 和 macOS 在用户体验和功能上的趋同，但完全合并 unlikely。

• **[对整体发布内容的调侃和质疑]** [Illniyar] 调侃 Apple 开始模仿 Windows Aero 设计。[xpe] 对 Apple 提供的超过 25 万个 API 感到震惊。[nehalem] 则质疑 Siri 为何没有在此次发布中被提及。

补充讨论：
• **[对 iPad 编程潜力的关注]** [chakintosh] 提到 iPad 已经接近 MacBook Air 的功能，除了特定专业需求外，可能不再需要其他设备。[mohsen1] 则对 iPad 编程的未来持谨慎乐观态度，特别是新的更新可能鼓励更多人尝试在 iPad 上进行编程。

争议焦点：
• **容器化框架的实际效果**：开发者对 macOS 原生容器化支持抱有很高期望，但目前的解决方案似乎仍基于虚拟机，而非真正的内核级容器化，这让部分开发者感到失望。

• **AI 模型的适用范围**：虽然 Apple 推出了新的 AI 模型和工具，但其对旧设备的支持有限，使得第三方开发者对其实用性存在疑虑。

44226978.article_content:
opens in new window
PRESS RELEASE
June 9, 2025
Apple supercharges its tools and technologies for developers to foster creativity, innovation, and design
Access to the on-device Apple Intelligence model, large language model integration in Xcode, and an elegant new software design across Apple platforms give developers everything they need to build beautiful modern apps with speed and confidence
Apple announced new technologies and enhancements to its developer tools to help developers create more beautiful, intelligent, and engaging app experiences across Apple platforms.
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA
Apple today announced new technologies and enhancements to its developer tools to help developers create more beautiful, intelligent, and engaging app experiences across Apple platforms. A beautiful new software design brings more focus to content, and delivers more expressive and delightful experiences across iOS 26, iPadOS 26, macOS Tahoe 26, watchOS 26, and tvOS 26,
1
while keeping them all instantly familiar. The Foundation Models framework joins a suite of tools that allow developers to tap into on-device intelligence, and Xcode 26 leverages large language models like ChatGPT, giving them access to Xcode’s Coding Tools and other intelligent features.
These new resources join the extensive and continuously evolving set of technologies Apple offers developers, including over 250,000 APIs that enable developers to integrate their apps with Apple’s hardware and software features. These APIs span a wide range of capabilities, such as machine learning, augmented reality, health and fitness, spatial computing, and high-performance graphics. With each platform release, Apple expands and refines its technologies and tools to assist developers in bringing their ideas to life and delivering rich, responsive, and optimized experiences across Apple platforms.
“Developers play a vital role in shaping the experiences customers love across Apple platforms,” said Susan Prescott, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations. “With access to the on-device Apple Intelligence foundation model and new intelligence features in Xcode 26, we’re empowering developers to build richer, more intuitive apps for users everywhere.”
New Design with Liquid Glass
The elegant new design gives developers the opportunity to make their apps more expressive and delightful, while being instantly familiar. It’s crafted with a new software-based material called Liquid Glass, which combines the optical qualities of glass with a sense of fluidity. This gorgeous new material extends from the smallest elements users interact with every day — like buttons, switches, sliders, text, and media controls — to larger elements, including tab bars and sidebars for navigating apps.
The elegant new design, crafted with Liquid Glass, gives developers the opportunity to make their apps more expressive and delightful, while being instantly familiar.
Native frameworks like SwiftUI give developers everything they need to adopt the new design in their apps. The universal design allows developers to bring greater focus to their users’ content, establishing a consistent experience when developing across Apple’s platforms.
With the all-new Icon Composer app, developers and designers are empowered to create visually captivating app icons that enhance their app’s identity. This powerful tool helps create a consistent visual identity for app icons by annotating layers for multiple rendering modes, with advanced features that include blurring, adjusting translucency, testing specular highlights, and previewing icons in various tints.
With the all-new Icon Composer app, both developers and designers are empowered to create visually captivating app icons that enhance their app’s identity.
Foundation Models Framework
With the Foundation Models framework, developers will be able to build on Apple Intelligence to bring users new experiences that are intelligent, available when they’re offline, and that protect their privacy, using AI inference that is free of cost.
The framework has native support for Swift, so developers can easily access the Apple Intelligence model with as few as three lines of code. Guided generation, tool calling, and more are all built into the framework, making it easier than ever to implement generative capabilities right into an existing app. For example, Automattic is using the framework in its Day One journaling app to bring users privacy-centric intelligence features.
“The Foundation Model framework has helped us rethink what’s possible with journaling,” said Paul Mayne, head of Day One at Automattic. “Now we can bring intelligence and privacy together in ways that deeply respect our users.”
Automattic is using the Foundation Models framework in its Day One journaling app to bring users privacy-centric intelligent features.
Xcode 26
Xcode 26 is packed with intelligence features and experiences to help developers make their ideas a reality.
Develope

data.title: The “Frankfurt Kitchen”
data.author: tosh
data.article_summary: “Frankfurt Kitchen”是由维也纳建筑师Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky于1926年设计的标准化厨房原型，旨在提高效率并引入工业化生产，以降低成本。约10,000套此类厨房在法兰克福多个住宅区实现，适应了战后住房短缺的需求。厨房设计灵感来自火车餐车，注重功能性和理性化工作流程，通过滑门与客厅分隔，并采用组合煤/电炉。该设计成为现代整体厨房的雏形，强调标准化、功能主义和客观性，反映了包豪斯和Werkbund的理念，即通过统一设计缩小阶级差异。然而，20世纪70-80年代，该厨房的性别化劳动分工受到批评，尽管其初衷是减轻家务负担，但未挑战传统的性别角色。博物馆展品包括历史照片、影片及对设计师的采访，供访客深入了解。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Frankfurt Kitchen的设计理念、功能性及其在现代生活中的应用与争议

不同观点：
• detourdog：分享了自己将旧学校改造为工作室公寓的项目，借鉴了Frankfurt Kitchen的设计，厨房目前功能较为简陋，但计划进一步增加细节和功能。
• comrade1234：对比了开放式厨房和传统的走廊式厨房，表达了对后者在烹饪效率上的偏好，尽管现代美学偏好开放式设计。
• eadmund：质疑了“计划秩序”优于“无序混乱”的假设，指出任何设计者都有其偏见和局限性，设计的通用性可能无法适应所有文化和个人需求。
• esafak：认为Frankfurt Kitchen的设计类似于现代的走廊式厨房，并指出其灵感可能来源于铁路餐车的厨房设计。
• boyka：以幽默的方式质疑Frankfurt Kitchen没有淋浴功能，暗示对其实用性的怀疑。
• SamBam：关注厨房储物设计的功能性，推测其储物箱的用途，并表达了对这种设计在个人工作空间中的潜在应用的兴趣。
• ginko：提供了与Frankfurt Kitchen设计者相关的历史信息，邀请人们参观设计者在维也纳的公寓。
• DocTomoe：分享了个人经历，描述了20世纪80年代Frankfurt厨房的普遍性及其在不同家庭中的文化适应，同时提到当时流行的装饰风格。
• throw0101d：补充了Frankfurt Kitchen历史背景信息，强调其设计初衷是为了建设健康的人类居住环境，并摒弃了纯装饰性的建筑设计。
• eclecticfrank：认为Frankfurt Kitchen的设计过于功能化，使其看起来像实验室或防空洞，可能缺乏生活气息。

• 争议焦点在于设计的通用性与个性化需求之间的矛盾，eadmund和DocTomoe都提到了设计无法满足所有个人和文化需求的问题。
• 不同用户对厨房设计的功能性和美学有不同偏好，如comrade1234偏好传统走廊式厨房的烹饪效率，而现代设计更倾向于开放式空间。
• 历史背景和文化影响在讨论中被多次提及，如Prilblumen风格的流行和Frankfurt Kitchen在20世纪住房中的应用。
• 用户分享了丰富的资源链接，如博物馆展示、视频资料和相关历史文献，为讨论提供了更多背景信息和视觉参考。

44210649.article_content:
“Frankfurt Kitchen” in the display collection of the Werkbundarchiv – Museum der Dinge, taken from the Römerstadt estate, Frankfurt, 1927/28
© Werkbundarchiv – Museum der Dinge
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” is an important document of cultural history for the transfer of industrial, rationalized work processes to the sphere of the private household. This is a central characteristic of modern architecture and everyday culture in the 1920s.
The Viennese architect Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky designed the kitchen in 1926 as a standard prototype. Some 10,000 such kitchens were realized in numerous variants in the Frankfurt estates. Schütte-Lihotzky was commissioned by the Frankfurt building inspector Ernst May, who was both the architectural designer and the local administrator responsible for the “New Frankfurt” of the 1920s. In view of the scarcity of rental housing in Frankfurt after the First World War, this building programme was intended to produce cheap, efficient housing with an economical use of use space and simple, economical furnishings for a growing population. The housing estate building programme, supported mainly by the SPD, was politically motivated and aimed at providing the technical and hygienic standards of the day — running water, gas and electricity — to the lower classes. The programme was publicized through a modern campaign. As part of that campaign, the kitchen was presented and well received at the Frankfurt spring fair of 1927.
The development of a standardized modular system made it possible to reduce the floor area required, and also permitted mass production which lowered costs further.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” was widely marketed and became the model for the fitted kitchen of today. There is not just one Frankfurt Kitchen, however. The model underwent several changes during the period in which it was realized in a number of Frankfurt estates until 1930.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” was designed to be efficient and functional, modeled after railway dining car kitchens, and planned based on taylorized work processes. It was intended to be used as a “cooking workroom”, and divided from the sitting room by a sliding door.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” specimen in the display collection of the Werkbundarchiv – Museum der Dinge was taken from a two-family terrace house at Heidenfeld 24 in the Römerstadt estate, built in 1927-28. The kitchens in the Römerstadt estate lacked the sliding door and the hay box that is present in other Frankfurt Kitchens, and was equipped with a combination coal/electric cooker. The kitchen cabinets were originally painted blue-green, and were repainted in a cream color during its years of use. The kitchen is exhibited in its unrestored state to show the authentic signs of use and modification. Paint has been removed from the fittings, however, and some missing parts have been replaced.
The ensemble is an ideal addition to the Museum’s collection because the Frankfurt Kitchen illustrates key principles of the 1920s: objectivity, functionalism, and above all, standardization. The concept of standardization was connected not only with production techniques, but also reflected the ideological position of the Bauhaus and Werkbund activists, who saw the uniform design of everyday objects as a contribution towards leveling the differences between classes. The artistic design of the standardized object served to refine it and to ensure that the right form was definitive.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” was one of the models propagated by the Werkbund and the Bauhaus for the “New Life” of the “New Man”, an idea that was widely popular in the 1920s. These visions involve a renunciation of historically determined elements of identity. Bruno Taut, in his book Die Neue Wohnung (“The New Home”), rejects the presence of mementos and any kind of “historic junk”. Erna Meyer, the academic housekeeping expert of the 1920s and 1930s, wrote: “Now it’s all or nothing: New Man needs a new skin!” (Wohnungsbau und Hausführung, 1927, 89).
A “planned order” was to replace the “senseless chaos” of the world. The notion of a regularly constructed reality corresponds to the principles of functionalism and rationality conditioned by industrial production processes. Both objects and people were to conform to these principles.
The consequences of these reformative initiatives, especially in housing estate architecture, were criticized in debates on socially supported housing in the 1970s and 1980s. The image of women that is evident in the Frankfurt Kitchen concept must also be viewed critically. A purely functional working kitchen was intended to make housework easier, but without questioning the gendered division of labour.
Alongside the actual kitchen exhibited in the museum, visitors can examine an audiovisual installation based on historic photos and films, a 1985 interview with the designing architect, Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky, and the findings of two researchers who spent years studying the Frankfurt Kitche

• comrade1234：对比了开放式厨房和传统的走廊式厨房，表达了对后者在烹饪效率上的偏好，尽管现代美学偏好开放式设计。
• eadmund：质疑了“计划秩序”优于“无序混乱”的假设，指出任何设计者都有其偏见和局限性，设计的通用性可能无法适应所有文化和个人需求。

data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了网站为了防止AI公司大规模抓取数据导致的服务器过载，采用了名为Anubis的保护系统。Anubis使用了一种类似于Hashcash的“工作量证明”机制，增加大规模抓取的成本，同时尽量不影响普通用户。其目的是在开发更精准的识别技术之前，提供一个临时的解决方案。用户需要启用现代JavaScript功能，某些插件可能需要禁用才能正常访问网站。当前网站使用的Anubis版本是1.19.1。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：语法高亮的实用性及其局限性，特别是在Vim等编辑器中的实现方式，以及可能的替代方案或改进方向。

不同观点：
• norir认为语法高亮常常让人分心，并且在解决问题时没有实际帮助。他更希望获得关于代码正确性的直接反馈，而不是仅仅依赖语法高亮。他主张手动高亮，并建议开发更智能、更快速的编译器来直接响应代码问题。
• chrismorgan承认粗略解析在基础编程语言中的作用，但指出其在语义细节上的不足。他提到Vim等编辑器的语法高亮存在局限性，特别是在处理函数定义和调用时，且在处理某些语言如C时尤其明显。他还提到，Vim的语法高亮有时会导致编辑速度变慢，需要更好的工具来识别问题所在。
• frou_dh支持完全准确的语法高亮，认为不准确的高亮（假阳性和假阴性）会对用户产生负面影响。他强调了准确高亮的优点，并暗示这是提升编辑器体验的重要因素。
• b0a04gl指出Vim的语法引擎缺乏对上下文的跟踪，无法处理如ysh语言中命令和表达模式混合的情况。他主张停止在Vim中叠加各种技巧，建议在外部生成语义标记，让Vim只负责渲染。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了对Vim语法高亮的具体技术限制，特别是其在处理复杂语言结构时的不足。
• 有人提到Oils等新语言通过明确的关键字（如`proc`）来简化语法高亮，这表明语言设计本身也可能影响高亮的效果。
• 讨论还涉及到对更智能工具和编译器的需求，这些工具可以提供更直接的代码反馈，而不仅仅是通过语法高亮。

争议焦点：语法高亮是否有助于编程效率，还是反而会成为一种视觉干扰。另外，Vim的语法高亮机制是否足够高效和准确，是否需要外部工具的辅助。

44265216.article_content:
Making sure you're not a bot!
Loading...
Why am I seeing this?
You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up
Anubis
to protect the server against the scourge of
AI companies aggressively scraping websites
. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.
Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a
Proof-of-Work
scheme in the vein of
Hashcash
, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.
Ultimately, this is a hack whose real purpose is to give a "good enough" placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.
Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like
JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.
This website is running Anubis version
1.19.1
.

data.title: Rendering Crispy Text on the GPU
data.author: ibobev
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：SDF（Signed Distance Field）文本渲染技术及其在现代系统和应用中的使用情况，包括其优势、局限性以及实现上的挑战。

不同观点：
• [oofabz] 认为SDF文本渲染技术自Valve在2007年提出以来一直是游戏领域的热门技术，但在现代操作系统和浏览器中并未广泛采用，仍然依赖于1990年代的Truetype光栅化技术。尽管SDF技术具备很多优势，如快速变换文本，但由于技术实现复杂、性能风险高，主流浏览器和操作系统未采用这种技术。

• [meindnoch] 认为子像素抗锯齿（subpixel antialiasing）在现代高分辨率屏幕上效果有限，且存在诸多缺点，如只能在不透明背景下使用，应用效果（如缩放、镜像等）受限。因此，认为子像素渲染技术已经过时。

• [enriquto] 强烈反对任意位置放置字形，认为这会导致字符在每次打印时看起来不同，影响视觉一致性。他主张使用高质量的位图字体，认为这种字体在现代显示器上更加清晰，且不依赖于显示器的gamma值。

• [kvemkon] 提到GTK4已经将渲染移至GPU，但放弃了RGB子像素渲染，并质疑文章中提出的解决方案是否在技术栈中具有实际可操作性。

• [vFunct] 质疑为何需要离线渲染文本并存储在图集（atlas）中，而不是直接通过着色器渲染文本。他认为应该有办法将贝塞尔曲线转换为三角网格，从而在GPU上直接渲染文本。

补充讨论：
• [xiaoiver] 提供了关于如何在WebGL / WebGPU中实现SDF和MSDF的教程链接，为有兴趣的读者提供了实践指导。

• [dcrazy] 提到了Slug库，这是一个实现GPU字形光栅化的商业中间件，为需要实现类似功能的人提供了参考。

• [b0a04gl] 提出了一个关于为何SDF字形需要大量前期准备工作的问题，并将其与视频纹理的实时流传输进行了对比。

• [favorited] 提到了一个关于使用MSDF进行GPU文本渲染的会议演讲，提供了额外的学习资源。

• [pjmlp] 认为文章缺少WebGL/WebGPU的演示，仅有视频，建议提供更多互动性的示例。

争议焦点：
• SDF文本渲染技术在现代系统中的适用性及其相对于传统光栅化技术的优劣。
• 子像素抗锯齿技术在现代高分辨率屏幕上的实际效果和必要性。
• 是否应该直接通过着色器渲染文本，而非依赖离线渲染和图集存储。

这些观点共同构成了关于SDF文本渲染技术及其在实际应用中的挑战和潜力的多角度讨论。

data.title: Urban Design and Adaptive Reuse in North Korea, Japan, and Singapore
data.author: daveland
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了亚洲城市适应性再利用的复杂性，通过采访建筑师Calvin Chua，探讨了新加坡、日本和韩国在城市规划和建筑再利用方面的独特挑战和实践。新加坡的“分层商场”因碎片化所有权导致改造困难，许多店铺被退休人士用作社交场所，而非商业用途。韩国由于材料限制和政治因素，建筑设计受限，如平壤公寓的厚墙和强制使用亮色。日本通过改造废弃的传统民宅（kominka），使濒临消失的乡村重现生机，甚至吸引了国际投资。Chua强调，成功的适应性再利用需兼顾建筑结构和社区精神，单保存建筑或只关注社区都可能导致问题。他通过研究和项目展示了隐藏在城市发展背后的力量，强调理解实际需求和限制的重要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过对亚洲城市规划的观察，讨论不同国家的商业地产所有权模式、建筑设计理念以及其对社会结构的影响，并对比这些模式是否适用于美国。

不同观点：
• [nayuki] 观点：介绍了新加坡的"strata malls"模式，即个体可以购买商铺的所有权而不是租赁，并且任何建筑改造需要80%的所有者同意。这种模式导致了一些退休人士将店铺作为社交场所，拒绝高额买断，使得这些商场成为小众商业和退休社区的聚集地。同时，提到多伦多的类似现象，一些“死气沉沉的商场”因为商铺为个人所有，无法随意更换租户，导致商场内的商铺种类难以调整。

• [decimalenough] 观点：对建筑技术表示兴趣，尤其是对不使用大量钢材建造高楼的可能性感到惊讶，推测可能是使用了承重墙的结构。

• [contrarian1234] 观点：对采访中的学术语言和模糊表述持批评态度，认为 interviewee 过于自恋且缺乏具体的实例，虽然提出了一些好的想法，但整体显得空洞。特别批评了“重新思考外围的议程”这种术语，认为其空洞且令人反感。同时，对采访中关于“英雄建筑”的讨论表示赞赏，但对 interviewee 的回应不满意。

• [Onavo] 观点：认为通过亚洲城市规划的视角来研究美国的 YIMBY 运动存在问题，因为亚洲国家的公民权利和私有财产制度与美国有很大不同。例如，日本因自然灾害频繁需要经常重建住房，新加坡是一个强政府模式，土地多为国家所有，而韩国则面临人口负增长问题。因此，认为这些亚洲模式对美国并不适用。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于对采访内容的评价，[contrarian1234] 认为 interviewee 的表述过于模糊且缺乏实际案例，而 [daveland] 则对采访进行了简化和编辑，去掉了冗长的部分，认为采访本身还是有价值的。
• [Onavo] 提出了亚洲国家与美国在城市规划和房产制度上的根本性差异，质疑将亚洲模式直接应用于美国的可行性。
• [nayuki] 通过具体实例（新加坡和多伦多的商场）展示了不同所有权模式对商业地产的影响，强调了这种模式对商场内部商业生态的长期影响。

总结：讨论涉及了亚洲城市规划中的不同商业地产所有权模式、建筑设计理念及其对社会结构的影响，并对这些模式是否适用于美国提出了质疑。争议点在于对学术语言和空洞表述的批评，以及对亚洲模式在美国的适用性的怀疑。

We debate policy and push for development, but what about the actual city that emerges? For my fellow urbanists and YIMBYs, I hope this interview offers something a bit new. The aesthetics, forms, and textures born from history, politics, resources, and constraints. Beyond regulations and economic models, how do planning ideas manifest visually? What does adaptive reuse mean beyond headline projects?
Cities don't follow master plans, but what exactly does that mean? They're shaped by who owns what, what materials are available, and what communities actually need. Calvin Chua and his firm,
Spatial Anatomy
, studies these hidden forces through design projects, research, and strategic planning across challenging contexts worldwide. He also teaches design studios at SUTD focusing on peripheral zones and adaptation paradigms and was the festival director of Singapore’s Archifest 2023. He written a few interesting books including
Singapore Strata Malls: A Retrospective for the Future
and
Unit. Volume 2: Golden Mile Complex
.

Singapore: When Ownership Gets Complicated
Singapore's "strata malls" let individuals own shops outright, not rent them. Any building change needs 80% owner approval. Result: retirees treating shops as social clubs, refusing million-dollar buyouts. These malls become uncurated havens for niche businesses and retirement communities disguised as retail.
Chua discovered this while researching strata malls and planning Paya Lebar Air Base redevelopment. Finding that owners saw shops as retirement security changed how his team approached preserving 1,800 hectares of heritage buildings.
Singapore labels everything temporary as "interim": schools, housing, bus stops. These "temporary" solutions routinely last 20+ years.
Korean Peninsula: Design Across Division
For the 2017 Seoul Biennale, Chua built a replica Pyongyang apartment in Seoul. 36 square meters showing how people actually live versus headlines about missiles. His "Pyonghattan" project used replication to make complex conditions accessible without sensationalizing.
From 2012-2019, Chua trained urban planners in Pyongyang through an NGO. He goes over the constraints: no steel imports mean everything's concrete. Result: 40-story towers with walls so thick they eat living space. Kim Jong-un mandates bright colors for modernity, creating colorful but chunky buildings. Juche self-reliance ideology made physical.
Nuances of Adaptive Reuse
Chua distinguishes between different scales and models of reuse. High-capital conversions like Tate Modern (power plant to museum) or Zeitz MOCAA (grain silo to gallery) grab headlines as architectural showpieces. Every city wants one. But these represent just one approach.
More compelling to Chua are systematic, community-focused efforts. Karl Bengs renovating abandoned kominka in dying Japanese villages creates actual homes, not tourist attractions. Some villages see their first births in decades. This model now attracts international investors, creating a new rural real estate sector. The tension: are we saving communities or displacing them?
Even temporary reuse matters. For Singapore Archifest 2023, Chua curated "Interim: Acts of Adaptation," exploring how spaces awaiting demolition could be activated. He wanted to take over the vacated Golden Mile Complex for a month but settled for activating heritage precincts with pavilions. The Green Agora project during COVID showed how modular structures in peripheral farms could become community gathering spaces that evolve over time.
The key insight across all scales: successful adaptation requires understanding both structure and spirit. Preserving buildings without their communities creates museums. Maintaining communities without functional spaces leads to decay. The challenge is achieving both.
Overall
Think ethnographic research that scales up. Small finding (shop owners see stores as retirement security) reshapes massive planning (airbase redevelopment). He literally builds replicas of spaces to make complex conditions understandable. No manifestos, just "walk through this and you'll get it."

44265105.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了亚洲城市适应性再利用的复杂性，通过采访建筑师Calvin Chua，探讨了新加坡、日本和韩国在城市规划和建筑再利用方面的独特挑战和实践。新加坡的“分层商场”因碎片化所有权导致改造困难，许多店铺被退休人士用作社交场所，而非商业用途。韩国由于材料限制和政治因素，建筑设计受限，如平壤公寓的厚墙和强制使用亮色。日本通过改造废弃的传统民宅（kominka），使濒临消失的乡村重现生机，甚至吸引了国际投资。Chua强调，成功的适应性再利用需兼顾建筑结构和社区精神，单保存建筑或只关注社区都可能导致问题。他通过研究和项目展示了隐藏在城市发展背后的力量，强调理解实际需求和限制的重要性。
44265105.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过对亚洲城市规划的观察，讨论不同国家的商业地产所有权模式、建筑设计理念以及其对社会结构的影响，并对比这些模式是否适用于美国。

不同观点：
• [nayuki] 观点：介绍了新加坡的"strata malls"模式，即个体可以购买商铺的所有权而不是租赁，并且任何建筑改造需要80%的所有者同意。这种模式导致了一些退休人士将店铺作为社交场所，拒绝高额买断，使得这些商场成为小众商业和退休社区的聚集地。同时，提到多伦多的类似现象，一些“死气沉沉的商场”因为商铺为个人所有，无法随意更换租户，导致商场内的商铺种类难以调整。

• [decimalenough] 观点：对建筑技术表示兴趣，尤其是对不使用大量钢材建造高楼的可能性感到惊讶，推测可能是使用了承重墙的结构。

• [contrarian1234] 观点：对采访中的学术语言和模糊表述持批评态度，认为 interviewee 过于自恋且缺乏具体的实例，虽然提出了一些好的想法，但整体显得空洞。特别批评了“重新思考外围的议程”这种术语，认为其空洞且令人反感。同时，对采访中关于“英雄建筑”的讨论表示赞赏，但对 interviewee 的回应不满意。

• [Onavo] 观点：认为通过亚洲城市规划的视角来研究美国的 YIMBY 运动存在问题，因为亚洲国家的公民权利和私有财产制度与美国有很大不同。例如，日本因自然灾害频繁需要经常重建住房，新加坡是一个强政府模式，土地多为国家所有，而韩国则面临人口负增长问题。因此，认为这些亚洲模式对美国并不适用。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于对采访内容的评价，[contrarian1234] 认为 interviewee 的表述过于模糊且缺乏实际案例，而 [daveland] 则对采访进行了简化和编辑，去掉了冗长的部分，认为采访本身还是有价值的。
• [Onavo] 提出了亚洲国家与美国在城市规划和房产制度上的根本性差异，质疑将亚洲模式直接应用于美国的可行性。
• [nayuki] 通过具体实例（新加坡和多伦多的商场）展示了不同所有权模式对商业地产的影响，强调了这种模式对商场内部商业生态的长期影响。

总结：讨论涉及了亚洲城市规划中的不同商业地产所有权模式、建筑设计理念及其对社会结构的影响，并对这些模式是否适用于美国提出了质疑。争议点在于对学术语言和空洞表述的批评，以及对亚洲模式在美国的适用性的怀疑。

data.title: Jemalloc Postmortem
data.author: jasone
data.article_summary: Jason Evans回顾了jemalloc内存分配器的发展历程。jemalloc始于2004年Lyken编程语言项目中的手动内存分配器，尽管Lyken项目最终失败，但其内存分配器被集成到FreeBSD中，成为jemalloc。在FreeBSD中，jemalloc解决了多处理器环境下的可扩展性问题，但初期存在严重的内存碎片问题，经过研究和调整，最终采用了按大小分类的区域分配策略。随后，jemalloc被应用于Firefox以解决Windows平台的高碎片问题，并进行了跨平台移植。在Facebook工作期间，jemalloc进一步发展，增加了对内存泄漏调试工具的支持和多种功能改进。尽管jemalloc将永久开源，但其主动开发已结束。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Jemalloc的现状、性能、使用情况及其未来发展

不同观点：
• [Svetlitski] 认为Jemalloc仍然是最好的通用malloc实现之一，但对默认设置的现代化持建议态度，如禁用“cache oblivious”设置和增加默认页大小。他还提到TCMalloc虽然在Bazel环境下使用较为方便，但对非Bazel用户依然不便。
• [adityapatadia] 分享了Jemalloc在他们公司的成功应用经验，解决了内存碎片化问题，表达了对Jemalloc的感激之情。
• [masklinn] 指出Jemalloc从Rust中移除是多因素作用的结果，并提供了相关Issue链接以供参考。
• [wiz21c] 对文章中描述的工作环境表示担忧，认为其不像是一个正常的工作场所。
• [schrep] 对Jemalloc的长期影响力表示敬意，并对自己曾参与其中感到荣幸。
• [chubot] 询问Facebook是否仍在使用Jemalloc，或者是否已进入维护模式，并提到Facebook可能使用TCMalloc或其他分配器。
• [meisel] 指出Jemalloc在macOS上能够无缝替代malloc/free，而其他分配器在这方面存在问题。
• [Twirrim] 关注Jemalloc在Redis等项目中的使用及其可能的性能影响。
• [mavis] 分享了Jemalloc解决内存泄漏问题的个人经验。
• [gdiamos] 对Jemalloc的成就表示赞赏，并认为其对许多内存分配器具有启发作用。
• [b0a04gl] 提到在不知情的情况下长期使用Jemalloc，并对其性能和调优选项表示赞赏。
• [kstrauser] 对Jemalloc未成为默认分配器表示疑问，并希望了解更多技术细节。
• [p0w3n3d] 对大科技公司使用免费软件但贡献较少表示不满，希望Jemalloc的作者是个例外。
• [nevon] 最近使用Jemalloc解决了内存碎片化问题，但对其未来发展和其他分配器如TCMalloc的性能表示关注。
• [poorman] 幽默地建议Doug Lea开发现代多线程版的dlmalloc2。

补充讨论：
• Jemalloc的性能和易用性是讨论的焦点，尤其是与其他分配器（如TCMalloc）的对比。
• 不同用户分享了Jemalloc在实际应用中的成功经验，显示了其广泛的影响力和实用性。
• 对Jemalloc未来发展及其在不同环境下的适用性存在一定争议和不确定性，部分用户对其长期维护表示担忧。
• 对开源软件的贡献和使用问题也被提及，反映了对免费软件生态系统可持续性的关注。

争议焦点：Jemalloc是否应继续作为默认分配器及其未来发展方向。

44264958.article_content:
Jason Evans
@jasone
Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, USA
Home
jemalloc Postmortem
Published Jun 12, 2025
The
jemalloc
memory allocator was first conceived in early 2004, and has
been in public use for about 20 years now. Thanks to the nature of open source software licensing,
jemalloc will remain publicly available indefinitely. But active upstream development has come to an
end. This post briefly describes jemalloc’s development phases, each with some success/failure
highlights, followed by some retrospective commentary.
Phase 0: Lyken
In 2004 I began work on the Lyken programming language in the context of scientific computing. Lyken
was an eventual dead end, but its manual memory allocator was functionally complete by May 2005.
(The garbage collector which was to leverage its features was never completed.) In September 2005 I
started integrating the allocator into FreeBSD, and in March 2006 I removed the allocator from
Lyken, in favor of thin wrappers around system allocator functionality.
Why remove the memory allocator from Lyken after so much effort went into it? Well, once the
allocator was integrated into FreeBSD, it became apparent that the only feature missing from the
system allocator was a mechanism for tracking allocation volume in order to trigger per thread
garbage collection. And that could be implemented via thin wrappers using thread-specific data and
dlsym(3)
. Interestingly, many years later
jemalloc even added the statistics gathering that Lyken would have needed.
Phase 1: FreeBSD
Back in 2005 the transition to multi-processor computers was ongoing. FreeBSD had Poul-Henning
Kamp’s excellent phkmalloc memory allocator, but that allocator had no provisions for parallel
thread execution. Lyken’s allocator seemed like an obvious scalability improvement, and with
encouragement from friends and colleagues I integrated what quickly became known as jemalloc. Ah,
but not so fast! Shortly after integration it became apparent that jemalloc had terrible
fragmentation issues under some loads, notably those induced by
KDE
applications. Just when I thought I was mostly done, this real-world failure called jemalloc’s
viability into question.
In brief, the fragmentation issue arose from using a unified extent allocation approach (i.e. no
size class segregation). I had taken basic inspiration from Doug Lea’s
dlmalloc
, but without the intertwined battle-tested
heuristics that avoided many of the worst fragmentation issues. Much frantic research and
experimentation ensued. By the time jemalloc was part of a FreeBSD release, its layout algorithms
had completely changed to use size-segregated regions, as described in the
2006 BSDCan jemalloc
paper
.
Phase 1.5: Firefox
In November 2007,
Mozilla Firefox
3 was nearing
release, and high fragmentation was an unresolved issue, especially on Microsoft Windows. Thus began
a year of working with Mozilla on memory allocation. Porting jemalloc to Linux was trivial, but
Windows was another matter. The canonical jemalloc sources were in the FreeBSD libc library, so we
essentially forked jemalloc and added portability code, upstreaming anything that was relevant to
FreeBSD. The entire implementation was still in one file, which reduced the friction of fork
maintenance, but the implementation complexity definitely surpassed what is reasonable in a single
file sometime during this phase of development.
Years later, Mozilla developers made significant contributions to the upstream jemalloc in an effort
to move away from their fork. Unfortunately, Mozilla benchmarks consistently showed that the forked
version outperformed the upstream version. I don’t know if this was due to overfitting to a local
optimum or an actual indication of performance regression, but it remains one of my biggest jemalloc
disappointments.
Phase 2: Facebook
When I started work at Facebook in 2009, I was surprised to discover that the biggest impediment to
ubiquitous jemalloc use in Facebook infrastructure was instrumentation. Critical internal services
were in the awkward situation of depending on jemalloc to keep memory fragmentation under control,
but engineers needed to debug memory leaks with
tcmalloc
and
the
pprof
heap profiling tool that is part of
gperftools
.
pprof
-compatible heap profiling
functionality headlined the jemalloc 1.0.0 release.
jemalloc development migrated to
GitHub
and continued sporadically
for the next few years as issues and opportunities arose. Other developers started contributing
significant functionality. Version 3.0.0 introduced extensive testing infrastructure, as well as
Valgrind
support. The 4.x release series introduced decay-based purging and
JSON
-formatted telemetry. The 5.x series transitioned from
“chunks” to “extents” to pave the way for better interaction with 2 MiB huge pages.
Somewhat more controversially, I removed Valgrind support in 5.0.0 because it was a significant
maintenance complication (numerous tendrils in subtle places), and it was unused inside Facebook;

data.title: Show HN: Spark, An advanced 3D Gaussian Splatting renderer for Three.js
data.author: dmarcos
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一款先进的3D高斯点渲染器（Gaussian Splatting Renderer），专为THREE.js开发。该渲染器可以与其他网格和点效果集成，适用于各种设备并实现快速渲染。它支持可编程的动态点效果，并兼容多种文件格式（如ply、spz、splat、ksplat）。用户可以快速上手，将高效的3D渲染效果整合到自己的项目中。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Gaussian Splatting技术演示的性能、应用场景、技术细节及潜在问题

不同观点：
• 正面评价：
  - erulabs: 演示在旧版iPhone上运行良好，对游戏开发爱好者有吸引力，但对Gaussian Splatting缺乏了解，建议在GitHub或网站上添加定义说明。
  - jasonthorsness: 食物扫描演示非常出色，尤其在集成显卡笔记本上的性能表现惊人，询问该技术的常见应用场景。
  - ertucetin: 提到BabylonJS也支持Gaussian Splatting，并提供相关文档链接。
  - mbo: 对项目未来可能引入Web Components API表示期待，并提到A-Frame和<model-viewer>组件。

• 性能问题：
  - moshegramovsky: 演示在Firefox浏览器中性能较差，尽管使用Nvidia RTX A3000 GPU，暗示性能优化可能存在问题。
  - fidotron: 关注动态场景的性能瓶颈，特别是粒子模拟的表现，并指出静态背景的渲染负担。

• 实际应用及可行性：
  - VikingCoder: 提出是否可以通过手机扫描环境并创建类似Minecraft世界的设想，同时担心硬件性能需求。
  - socalgal2: 对Gaussian Splatting文件过大表示担忧，并提到类似技术在其他应用中的带宽需求问题，暗示技术实用性有限。

• 技术细节及格式：
  - imachine1980_: 询问Gaussian Splatting与.obj渲染的区别，是否产生不同格式。
  - danybittel: 关注渲染方法，询问是否使用排序实例（如radix排序），并询问性能满意度。

补充讨论：
• 命名问题：
  - Epa095: 提到“Spark”名称与其他技术（如Apache Spark、SPARK（Ada）、sparklines、SPARQL）重名，可能引起混淆。

• 访问问题：
  - bryzaguy: 在iPhone 16上因证书过期问题无法查看演示，页面被阻止。

• 功能扩展：
  - two_handfuls: 询问该技术是否支持在VR中通过浏览器打开，期待更出色的体验。

争议焦点：
• 性能表现：部分用户（如moshegramovsky和fidotron）指出演示在不同设备或浏览器中的性能问题，而其他用户（如erulabs和jasonthorsness）则对其性能表示赞赏。
• 实用性：socalgal2对文件大小和带宽需求表示担忧，认为技术目前仅限于演示，而VikingCoder则设想其实际应用场景。

data.title: Use-after-free in CAN BCM subsystem leading to information disclosure (CVE-2023
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary:
本文描述了2024年在Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9（RHEL 9）中发现的一个使用释放后内存（use-after-free）漏洞。该漏洞已在2023年7月17日于Linux内核上游被修复，但RHEL 9的修复补丁于2025年3月11日才发布。研究团队在2024年7月16日向Red Hat报告了此漏洞，并提供了概念验证（proof of concept）。随后，该漏洞被分配了CVE-2023-52922。

漏洞存在于CAN BCM子系统的`bcm_release()`函数中。当一个套接字被读取并同时通过`close()`释放时，可能导致`bcm_proc_show()`读取已释放的对象，造成使用释放后内存的问题。这一漏洞允许非特权用户从内核空间读取数据，可能导致敏感信息泄露和安全缓解措施被绕过。

简而言之，文章揭示了一个具体的Linux内核漏洞及其影响和修复过程，并提醒类似问题在CAN BCM子系统中的潜在模式。

44261238.article_content:
In 2024, our research team noticed and wrote proofs of concept for a use-after-free vulnerability affecting the latest Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 (RHEL 9). At the time, kernel version 5.14.0-503.15.1.el9_5. The vulnerability had been fixed on the Linux kernel upstream on July 17, 2023 [1][2]. After we reported it, it was backported to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 on March 11, 2025 [3], in the kernel version 5.14.0-503.31.1.el9_5.
We reported it to Red Hat on July 16, 2024, and they replied that upstream declined to issue a CVE and asked us for the proof of concept we had mentioned during the first contact. After sending a detailed report including a proof of concept, the CVE-2023-52922 [4] was assigned. This blog post also highlights a potential pattern that has been present in the CAN BCM subsystem, as at least another issue has already been reported and fixed.
This vulnerability allows unprivileged users to read data from kernel space, which could be used to disclose sensitive information and bypass security mitigations enabled by default in the affected systems.
As is widely known, many network protocols create proc entries. For CAN BCM, these entries are located at
/proc/net/can-bcm/[ENTRY]
and can be read using the
read()
system call. However, suppose a socket with a given entry [ENTRY] is read and concurrently released with close(). In that case, the objects to be printed out can be freed while the function reading them is still executing, leading to use-after-free scenarios. This happens because
bcm_release()
first calls
bcm_remove_op()
on items on the lists
bo->tx_ops
and
bo->rx_ops
and then calls
remove_proc_entry()
to delete the proc entry, creating a time window that allows
bcm_proc_show()
to read freed objects.

data.title: Researchers discover evidence in the mystery of America's 'Lost Colony'
data.author: ryan_j_naughton
data.article_summary: 考古学家马克·霍顿（Mark Horton）及其团队经过十年研究，认为发现了失踪的罗阿诺克殖民者的下落。1587年，殖民地首领约翰·怀特返回英格兰补给，当他1590年返回时，罗阿诺克殖民地已人去楼空，仅留下“CROATOAN”的刻字。新证据表明，殖民者可能并未遭遇不幸，而是融入了附近的克罗托安社会。霍顿在哈特拉斯岛（原克罗托安岛）发现了铁锤鳞（hammerscale），这是殖民者进行冶铁的证据，而当时的美洲原住民不具备这种技术。出土的16世纪英国文物，包括枪支、航海配件和小炮球等，进一步证实殖民者在此生活并与原住民融合。

主要讨论点：罗阿诺克殖民地的消失及相关历史推测

不同观点：
• [bluGill] 认为，原住民没有锻造铁器的能力并不是因为缺乏智力或技能，而是由于缺乏优质的铁矿资源。他指出，只要有观察铁匠工作的机会和足够的尝试，人们可以通过反复试验学会锻造铁器。他还用反讽的方式提出外星人带走殖民者的假设，暗示对历史推测应保持谨慎。

• [derbOac] 基于考古和历史资料，认为殖民地的消失并非一次性事件，而是一个逐渐衰退的过程。他推测殖民者可能分别前往不同的地方，且可能没有完全断绝联系。他的观点强调了历史事件的复杂性和多可能性。

• [duxup] 对早期殖民者的经历表示兴趣，认为一些殖民地非常脆弱且准备不足，这可能是导致其消失的一个因素。

• [buildsjets] 对信息来源提出质疑，询问是否有来自可靠来源的报道。

• [chiefalchemist] 提出，如果殖民者与原住民同化并繁衍后代，应该存在DNA证据来支持这一假设。

• [CGMthrowaway] 简要总结认为，罗阿诺克殖民地迁移到了哈特拉斯岛，从内陆岛屿迁移到了靠近海的屏障岛。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了对历史推测的可靠性和证据支持的关注，例如对信息来源的质疑和对DNA证据的需求。
• 不同评论者对殖民地消失的原因和过程提出了多种可能性，包括资源的缺乏、逐渐衰退的过程以及具体的迁移地点。
• 争议的焦点在于历史事件推测的可靠性和证据的充分性，特别是关于信息来源和实物证据（如DNA）的需求。

总结：评论主要围绕罗阿诺克殖民地消失的各种历史推测展开讨论，涉及到资源的可用性、事件过程的复杂性以及证据的可靠性等问题。不同评论者提供了各自的见解和质疑，反映了历史研究中的多重可能性和挑战。

Video
Archaeologists discover evidence of Roanoke colonists' fate after abandoning settlement
Mark Horton, an archaeology professor at the Royal Agricultural University in the United Kingdom, spoke with Fox News Digital about his recent research that may reveal the fate of the Roanoke colonists.
NEW
You can now listen to Fox News articles!
A team of researchers believes they may have cracked one of America's most enduring legends: Where did the settlers of the
Roanoke Colony
go?
The Roanoke Colony, also known as the Lost Colony, was the first
English settlement
attempt in the United States. A group of over 100 colonists settled on North Carolina's Roanoke Island in 1587, led by Sir Walter Raleigh.
John White, the governor of the colony, returned to England for supplies in 1587. When he came back to Roanoke Island in August 1590, he found the settlement mysteriously abandoned – and all the colonists, including his daughter Eleanor Dare and his granddaughter Virginia Dare, gone.
DIVERS UNCOVER MYSTERIOUS 2,500-YEAR-OLD SHIPWRECK, FILLED WITH UNUSUAL ARTIFACTS, OFF COAST OF SICILY
One of the only clues remaining at the site was the word "CROATOAN" carved into a palisade. It either referred to Croatoan Island, which is now called Hatteras Island, or the Croatoan Indians.
The mystery has haunted Americans and Brits for the past four centuries, with several investigations launched into the matter. Whether the colonists were killed by Native Americans, starved to death or
left for greener pastures
has eluded historians.
After 10 years of research, an archaeologist spoke with Fox News Digital about his team's discoveries related to the lost Roanoke Colony.
(Mark Horton; Croatoan Archaeological Society)
But new research suggests the colonists' fate may not have been tragic after all.
Mark Horton, an archaeology professor at Royal Agricultural University in England, spoke with Fox News Digital about his findings.
"This is metal that has to be raised to a relatively high temperature … which, of course, [requires] technology that Native Americans at this period did not have."
For the past decade, the British researcher has worked with the Croatoan Archaeological Society's Scott Dawson to uncover the mystery. Horton said they've uncovered proof the colonists assimilated into Croatoan society, thanks to a trash heap.

data.title: Show HN: RomM – An open-source, self-hosted ROM manager and player
data.author: gassi
data.article_summary: RomM 是一个开源、自托管的 ROM 管理器和播放器，提供美观且功能强大的界面，适用于管理及游玩游戏收藏。它支持多平台、多种命名方案和自定义标签，可以从 IGDB、Screenscraper 和 MobyGames 等获取元数据，并支持从 SteamGridDB 获取自定义封面。RomM 允许直接通过浏览器使用 EmulatorJS 和 RuffleRS 游玩游戏，并支持多磁盘游戏、DLC、模组、补丁等功能。此外，它还支持与朋友分享库，并提供 Playnite 和 muOS 的官方应用。用户可以通过贡献指南参与项目，并在 Discord 社区获取技术支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕游戏数据库和游戏模拟管理工具（RomM）的讨论，包括其功能、隐私问题、技术实现和与其他工具的比较。

不同观点：
• [bogwog] 提出建立一个包含游戏设计数据库的设想，其中包含游戏片段演示功能，并认为这种实现具有独特性，但可能涉及法律风险。他个人对此项目感到兴奋，并计划建立个人实例。
• [bane] 对 RomM 项目的集成和未来充满期待，认为其在跨设备服务方面的潜力巨大，尤其是网页模拟技术的进步。不过，他个人更喜欢在各个设备上直接运行游戏，而非通过浏览器。
• [M95D] 关注隐私问题，认为从互联网获取数据意味着隐私风险，特别是游戏数据可能揭示个人信息，存在被用于广告目的的风险。
• [oersted] 提到 Playnite 作为 PC 游戏库管理工具的优势，并认为 RomM 和 Playnite 有相似的用户体验，推荐用户根据需求选择。
• [dawnerd] 使用 RomM 管理 GOG 游戏库，认为 RomM 能够实现完全离线管理，避免受制于游戏发行平台。
• [atrus] 感谢 RomM 项目使用 AGPLv3 许可证，并赞赏其清晰的文档和目录结构。
• [indigodaddy] 对 RomM 在移动设备上的表现感到惊喜，认为其体验优于以往的随机 retro 游戏网站。
• [roger_] 认为 RomM 需要增加 ROM 重命名和验证功能，以真正成为“ROM 管理器”。
• [pipes] 关注 RomM 的技术实现，特别是对 JS 模拟器和 libretro API 的实现感兴趣，并比较了 RomM 与 Retroarch 的优劣。
• [garrettjoecox] 和 [VonGuard] 都提到 RomM 相对于 Retroarch、Lakka.tv、EmuDeck 等工具的优势和不足，特别是浏览器播放体验和 Retroarch 核心移植问题。
• [zunk] 提出是否可以有一个通用导入文件夹，自动识别和移动 ROM 到正确的系统文件夹。
• [jfinnery] 希望 Docker 版本无需外部数据库支持，以简化操作和维护。
• [zahlman] 质疑“托管”的意义，并指出 ROM 玩家通常对游戏有更多了解，可能涉及自制内容。
• [shitloadofbooks] 分享了自己两年前制作类似工具的经历，并询问 RomM 是否直接从 ROM 文件中提取元数据。

补充讨论：
• 技术实现问题：包括 JS 模拟器的进展、libretro API 的实现、Docker 版本的外部数据库需求等。
• 隐私和数据安全：特别是从互联网获取游戏数据可能带来的隐私风险。
• 工具比较：RomM 与 Playnite、Retroarch、Lakka.tv、EmuDeck 等工具的功能和体验比较。
• 用户需求：包括 ROM 自动识别和移动、重命名和验证功能、以及 Docker 版本的简化操作等。

data.title: OpenPlanetData – Free Daily Planet OSM PBF and GOL Indexed Snapshots
data.author: lpellegr
data.article_summary: Open Planet Data是一个开放计划，旨在让获取和使用与地球相关的开放数据变得更加便捷和高效。其首个项目提供OpenStreetMap的每日快照，格式包括PBF和GOL。GOL格式通过Geodesk索引，支持快速空间查询。这些快照托管在Cloudflare R2存储服务上，确保全球快速访问。如有问题或反馈，可联系该团队。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕Cloudflare R2存储服务以及OSM数据处理和发布的讨论，包括技术实现、实用性及潜在问题。

不同观点：
• [jauntywundrkind] 对Cloudflare R2的潜力表示好奇，但也提到有人抱怨使用后可能会被迫进入更昂贵的合同。他还对OSM的diffs数据格式和每日全量刷新的技术原因感到困惑，认为自己可能遗漏了某些关键的技术细节。

• [pbsurf] 对项目表示赞赏，并分享了一个自己创建的简单项目，用于按需生成和提供矢量瓦片。

• [n4r9] 指出OSM的服务器每周发布一次完整的数据，但diffs的发布频率更高，并推测该项目通过这些diffs实现每日全量更新。

• [durkie] 首次了解到Geodesk格式，认为它对大量OSM数据处理非常有帮助，可以节省时间和存储空间。

• [tomrod] 对项目表示赞赏，但希望进一步了解其与Geofrabrik数据缓存的关系，并提到最初误以为是一个研究级别的数据缓存。

• [morgenkaffee] 称赞该项目，指出每个需要地图的公司都需要自己的每日diff服务器，并提到长期可靠运行的挑战，特别是如果OSM上游出现问题。

• [aeuropean12] 简单直接地表示赞赏和支持。

• [cyberax] 询问Geodesk是否可以用于瓦片渲染，提到自己托管的OSM渲染器速度不快。

• [ajsnigrutin] 询问是否存在离线查看器，可以实现离线地图的搜索和导航功能。

补充讨论：
• 关于Cloudflare R2的使用成本和实际效果存在一定争议，特别是数据下载量较大时的成本问题。
• Geodesk格式在OSM数据处理中的潜在应用和优势被多位讨论者提及，显示出其在实际操作中的实用性。
• 有人关注该项目在长期运行中的可靠性问题，特别是上游OSM数据出现问题时的应对措施。
• 关于离线查看器和渲染性能的问题也被提出，显示出对该项目在不同应用场景下的扩展需求。

data.author: voxadam
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了RISC-V架构在芯片行业中日益增长的影响力，尽管该行业长期依赖于旧有的处理器架构和软件兼容性。RISC-V提供了一种灵活的演进路径，而不是一次性跨越技术鸿沟。文章提到，尽管许多应用的工作负载主要是数据流问题，但RISC-V的模块化和开放性使其在汽车、人工智能和高性能计算等领域得到越来越多的应用。例如，NVIDIA在2024年出货了10亿个RISC-V内核用于GPU中。尽管RISC-V在汽车行业等领域面临一些技术和商业挑战，如责任归属和生态系统建设，但其潜在的成本节约优势正吸引更多关注。RISC-V已从嵌入式微控制器发展为影响多个行业的重要架构。

RISC-V’s Increasing Influence
Does the world need another CPU architecture when that no longer reflects the typical workload? Perhaps not, but it may need a bridge to get to where it needs to be.
June 12th, 2025 -
By:
Brian Bailey
The industry is increasingly talking about benefits brought by the RISC-V architecture, but is it even the right starting point? While it may not be perfect, it may provide the flexibility necessary to move forward gradually.
Computer architectures and software have followed in the footsteps of processors developed 80 years ago. They aimed to solve sequential, scalar arithmetic problems using a foundational technology that could solve any finite problem, provided it had sufficient memory.
The chip industry has shown its reluctance to move away from that approach, particularly in industries that still run software developed 50 years ago. Software paradigms and backward compatibility have a huge influence. It took decades before programming migrated from single processor to multi-processor architectures in any meaningful way, and it wasn’t until NVIDIA developed CUDA that applications targeting massively parallel processors started to be developed outside of highly specialized applications.
So why does the industry need another CPU architecture when a typical workload for many applications is a dataflow problem, with a small amount of control? The answer lies in the many ways in which the RISC-V architecture can be evolved, and some of these may enable a slow migration rather than attempting to cross a wide chasm.
A couple of weeks ago, the RISC-V community held its annual summit in Europe, showcasing the increasing manner in which RISC-V is being used and how its impact is increasing, particularly in application domains that do not have a lot of legacy software holding it back. “RISC-V is no longer just the tiny embedded microcontroller that you were not even aware of, that is in your product,” says Andrea Gallo, CEO for RISC-V International. “RISC-V has entered a different phase.”
This is backed up by others. “Compared to previous years in Europe, there was much more industrial attendance,” says Larry Lapides, executive director of business development at
Synopsys
. “The content was coming more from industry, and that has changed the tenor of the conference. What we’re seeing is that RISC-V is starting to intrude in places that we didn’t expect it to even five years ago.”
Gallo provided several examples of significant progress. “Infinium said they are adopting RISC-V for automotive,” he said. “The European Union is funding HPC projects and funding automotive projects. Meta is using it for AI in their accelerator cards. And NVIDIA estimated that last year, in 2024, they shipped 1 billion RISC-V cores in their GPUs.”
Others highlighted the significant advances of RISC-V in cutting-edge processors. “It is not only the low end, but processors serving as a co-processor or accelerator for GPUs in certain segments,” says Mohit Wani, principal product manager at Synopsys. “NVIDIA gave a presentation where they said they have almost 30 types of different kinds of functionalities across their portfolio, where RISC-V based cores are doing the job for those 30-plus functionalities.”
Some business and technical hurdles still must be overcome. “Automotive is increasingly looking into RISC-V,” says Roland Jancke, design methodology head in
Fraunhofer IIS’ Engineering of Adaptive Systems Division
. “They have been hesitant because RISC-V is an open architecture. In the automotive industry, you always need someone to blame if something goes wrong. This is hard if you do not have a single provider, but a community. Today, they are increasingly looking into RISC-V due to the potential cost reduction, because in automotive you look for every cent to lower the price. However, you need to have an ecosystem. data.title: Amsterdam's high-stakes experiment to create fair welfare AI
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了阿姆斯特丹市使用算法评估福利申请者潜在欺诈风险的计划，引发了关于AI公平性的全球争论。数字权利倡导者Hans de Zwart认为该算法存在根本性且无法解决的问题，而市府顾问Paul de Koning则对其提高效率和消除偏见的潜力感到自豪。尽管市府遵循了伦理AI的最佳实践，但在试行中发现该系统仍不够公平和有效。文章指出，全球范围内类似的AI系统常因设计缺陷和偏见测试不足导致歧视问题，引发了对自动化决策公平性的广泛关注。欧盟和拜登政府曾尝试推动“负责任的AI”，但实际执行中仍面临挑战。文章由MIT Technology Review、Lighthouse Reports和荷兰报纸Trouw联合撰写，深入分析了阿姆斯特丹的算法系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：评估系统在公共服务和福利系统中的设计目的和效果

不同观点：
• Spivak认为，当前的评估系统从设计之初就存在问题，其目的更多是为了拒绝申请而非帮助申请人。他指出，系统本可以设计成帮助人们通过实时检查错误并提示纠正的方式来提高申请成功率，而不是以削减成本为核心目标。Spivak强调，如果系统设计得当，甚至不需要复杂的AI，只需关注用户体验和帮助功能，就可以大幅改善服务质量。

• 另一种观点认为，这些评估系统往往被当作削减成本的工具来销售和实现。这种设计理念导致系统可能采取简单粗暴的方式，如随机拒绝一定比例的申请，而不考虑申请的实际质量或合法性。这种方法虽然有效率，但却牺牲了公正性和服务质量。

补充讨论：
• Spivak提到，尽管新系统尝试在减少调查对象数量上做出改进，但结果却适得其反，反而增加了被标记的福利申请数量。这表明系统设计不仅要在技术上改进，更需要在基本理念上进行反思。

• 讨论中涉及的争议焦点在于系统设计的初衷和实现方式：是为了提高效率和服务质量，还是单纯为了削减成本和减少福利支出。这一根本性的设计目标争议直接影响了系统的实际效果和公众信任。

This story is a partnership between
MIT Technology Review
,
Lighthouse Reports
, and
Trouw
, and was supported by the Pulitzer Center.
Two futures
Hans de Zwart, a gym teacher turned digital rights advocate, says that when he saw Amsterdam’s plan to have an algorithm evaluate every welfare applicant in the city for potential fraud, he nearly fell out of his chair.
It was February 2023, and de Zwart, who had served as the executive director of Bits of Freedom, the Netherlands’ leading digital rights NGO, had been working as an informal advisor to Amsterdam’s city government for nearly two years, reviewing and providing feedback on the AI systems it was developing.
According to the city’s documentation, this specific AI model—referred to as “Smart Check”—would consider submissions from potential welfare recipients and determine who might have submitted an incorrect application. More than any other project that had come across his desk, this one stood out immediately, he told us—and not in a good way. “There’s some very fundamental [and] unfixable problems,” he says, in using this algorithm “on real people.”
Related Story
Can you make AI fairer than a judge? Play our courtroom algorithm game
The US criminal legal system uses predictive algorithms to try to make the judicial process less biased. But there’s a deeper problem.
From his vantage point behind the sweeping arc of glass windows at Amsterdam’s city hall, Paul de Koning, a consultant to the city whose résumé includes stops at various agencies in the Dutch welfare state, had viewed the same system with pride. De Koning, who managed Smart Check’s pilot phase, was excited about what he saw as the project’s potential to improve efficiency and remove bias from Amsterdam’s social benefits system.
A team of fraud investigators and data scientists had spent years working on Smart Check, and de Koning believed that promising early results had vindicated their approach. The city had consulted experts, run bias tests, implemented technical safeguards, and solicited feedback from the people who’d be affected by the program—more or less following every recommendation in the ethical-AI playbook. “I got a good feeling,” he told us.
These opposing viewpoints epitomize a global debate about whether algorithms can ever be fair when tasked with making decisions that shape people’s lives. Over the past several years of efforts to use artificial intelligence in this way, examples of collateral damage have mounted: nonwhite job applicants weeded out of job
application pools in the US
, families being wrongly flagged for
child abuse investigations
in Japan, and low-income residents being
denied food subsidies
in India.
Proponents of these assessment systems argue that they can create more efficient public services by doing more with less and, in the case of welfare systems specifically, reclaim money that is allegedly being lost from the public purse. In practice, many were poorly designed from the start. They sometimes factor in personal characteristics in a way that leads to discrimination, and sometimes they have been deployed without testing for bias or effectiveness. In general, they offer few options for people to challenge—or even understand—the automated actions directly affecting how they live.
The result has been more than a decade of scandals. In response, lawmakers, bureaucrats, and the private sector, from Amsterdam to New York, Seoul to Mexico City, have been trying to atone by creating algorithmic systems that integrate the principles of “responsible AI”—an approach that aims to guide AI development to benefit society while minimizing negative consequences.
CHANTAL JAHCHAN
Developing and deploying ethical AI is a top priority for the European Union, and the same was true for the US under former president Joe Biden, who released a blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights. That plan was rescinded by the Trump administration, which has removed considerations of equity and fairness, including in technology, at the national level. Nevertheless, systems influenced by these principles are still being tested by leaders in countries, states, provinces, and cities—in and out of the US—that have immense power to make decisions like whom to hire, when to investigate cases of potential child abuse, and which residents should receive services first.
Amsterdam indeed thought it was on the right track. City officials in the welfare department believed they could build technology that would prevent fraud while protecting citizens’ rights. They followed these emerging best practices and invested a vast amount of time and money in a project that eventually processed live welfare applications. But in their pilot, they found that the system they’d developed was still not fair and effective. Why?

• **b0a04gl**认为这首1994年的诗歌反映了某种无法想象改变的心态，诗中的角色甚至从未考虑过自己可能会有所改变或获得幸运。这种深层次的心理状态是诗歌的核心，强调了一种对改变的绝望感。
• **dash2**将该诗歌与另一首关于弱小、缓慢生物的诗歌《The Armadillo》进行比较，指出其中也蕴含着战争的暗示，试图寻找两首诗歌之间的主题联系。
• **tptacek**对选择这首诗歌进行讨论表示疑问，质疑为什么要特别关注这首诗，暗示可能对讨论的重点或价值有所怀疑。
• **darepublic**引用诗歌中的一句话“Patience, the sport of truly chastened things”作为回应，可能认为这首诗歌的核心在于忍耐和经历磨难后的一种淡然态度。
• **neonate**提供了一个存档链接，可能希望其他人通过该链接获取更多背景资料或进一步阅读，但未明确表达自己的观点。

文章探讨了时间序列预测领域从传统统计方法（如ARIMA、SARIMA、Prophet）向“基础模型”的转变，这些新模型借鉴了大型语言模型（LLMs）的零样本和迁移学习能力，旨在解决多样化时间序列数据的预测问题。文章介绍了对几种新兴的时间序列基础模型（如Amazon Chronos、Google TimesFM、IBM Tiny Time-Mixers、Datadog Toto）的评估，目标是测试这些模型在处理不同数据流时的表现，尤其是对摄入量预测和多变量指标预测的准确性。

文章详细描述了评估方法、数据预处理步骤、评估指标（如MAPE），以及模型在实际场景中的表现。研究发现，基础模型在处理多样化数据流和复杂场景时展现了较强的适应性和效率，能够减少对每个数据流单独调参和训练的需求，从而提升了可扩展性和预测质量。然而，模型仍面临一些现实挑战，如对异常数据的鲁棒性和跨领域应用的稳定性。总体而言，基础模型为时间序列预测带来了新的可能性，但仍需进一步优化以应对复杂多变的实际环境。

不同观点：
• Fripplebubby：认为时间序列基础模型的概念存在缺陷。他指出，基础模型应能够完成超出其训练目标的任务，而文章中提到的模型只是解决了无需重新训练即可进行分布外预测的问题。他还提到，现有的ARIMA和Prophet模型已经很好地解决了这一问题，且所需的计算资源和超参数选择都相对较少。此外，他认为探讨LLM架构是否能提升单变量或多变量时间序列预测的准确性更有意义。

Introduction
In the last few years, the field of time-series forecasting has seen a fundamental shift. Where we once depended solely on classic statistical methods, think
ARIMA
,
SARIMA
, and
Prophet
, new “foundation” models have emerged, promising to bring the power and flexibility of large language models (LLMs) into the world of time-series data. The allure is obvious: can we build a single, reusable forecasting model that works across a variety of datasets and domains, instead of painstakingly training a new model for every scenario?
Parseable
is built to handle our users’ observability data at any scale, a nonstop stream of raw ingest counts, infrastructure vitals, and fine-grained application signals. Running a separate, hand-tuned forecasting model for every slice quickly turns into a treadmill: each new stream or workload tweak demands fresh hyper-params, retrains, and ever-growing config sprawl. All that manual churn slows forecasts and breeds drift, so the results never feel fully trustworthy.
Then came the rise of foundation models, which revolutionised natural language processing by offering strong zero-shot and transfer learning capabilities. Researchers began asking a natural question: if LLMs can generalise to new tasks with minimal retraining, could similar techniques be applied to time-series data? What if you could just hand any telemetry stream to a pre-trained foundation model and immediately get a high-quality forecast, regardless of whether the model had seen data from that source before?
Motivated by this possibility, we set out to benchmark a new generation of time-series foundation models,
Amazon Chronos
,
Google TimesFM
,
IBM Tiny Time-Mixers
, and
Datadog Toto
.
Our goal was to assess how well these models perform on two representative tasks: a relatively straightforward forecasting problem (predicting ingestion volumes) and a more complex multivariate problem (forecasting multiple pod-level metrics). Along the way, we compared them to classical baselines and took note of both practical and technical trade-offs.
This post details our methodology, the challenges we encountered, how we evaluated the models, and what we learned from putting foundation models to the test on real-world observability data.
Why Foundation Models?
The idea of “foundation models” has fundamentally changed how we approach complex machine learning problems. In natural language processing, models like GPT have shown that a single, large model trained on vast and diverse datasets can generalize well to entirely new tasks sometimes even without fine-tuning. This zero-shot capability means a single model can perform sentiment analysis, summarization, translation, or question-answering, just by changing the prompt.
In the world of time-series forecasting, the appeal of such flexibility is obvious, especially for modern data engineering and observability platforms. Traditionally, every new data stream whether it’s CPU utilization, request rates, or disk I/O required its own model, hyperparameter tuning, and regular retraining. For an SRE or platform engineer, this quickly becomes unmanageable as the number of streams explodes. If a pipeline ingests data from a hundred microservices, does every service metric really need its own hand-tuned ARIMA or Prophet model? The answer, up until recently, was “yes.”
Foundation models for time series are built to change that. The core motivation is scalability and adaptability: train a single, large model (often with billions of parameters) on a wide range of time-series datasets and let it learn the underlying “language” of temporal data. Once trained, this model should ideally handle a completely new telemetry stream, even if it has never seen data of that exact shape or domain before. In theory, you could input any new time series, whether it’s network packet counts, database query durations, or energy consumption readings and get a high-quality forecast without retraining.
This is a huge leap from traditional approaches. Classic statistical models like ARIMA or seasonal decomposition excel when you have clean, stationary data and a well-understood seasonal pattern, but fall short when faced with missing values, sudden regime changes, or non-standard periodicity. More importantly, these models can’t transfer knowledge from one dataset to another; every dataset is a blank slate.

data.title: Show HN: I wrote a BitTorrent Client from scratch
data.author: piyushgupta53
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个用Go语言实现的BitTorrent客户端——go-torrent-client。该项目实现了BitTorrent客户端的核心功能，包括种子文件解析、节点发现与通信以及文件下载。主要特性包括Bencode编码/解码、种子文件处理、节点发现与通信、以及下载管理（如分片和块管理、进度跟踪等）。项目结构清晰，包含命令行界面、内部包（如Bencode编码、种子处理、节点协议等）以及公共包。目前该项目正在积极开发中，未来计划支持磁力链接、元数据交换协议和DHT。需要Go 1.21或更高版本进行安装和使用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕一个Go语言编写的BitTorrent客户端的实现、功能、安全性、可扩展性及未来发展方向的评价与建议。

不同观点：
• [jorkingit] 关注安全性，提出动态分配大小应有限制，以防止恶意输入通过请求极大的分配导致拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。建议使用剩余的输入长度作为上限。
• [vkaku] 对项目表示赞赏，并建议在README中添加简单的一行使用说明，还提出了增加从URL解析种子的功能，认为这对个人学习有益。
• [__jonas] 提到一个相关的学习资源，即codecrafters上的BitTorrent课程，提供了测试和指导，认为这是一个有趣的学习途径。
• [ashirviskas] 对使用Go 1.21旧版本提出疑问，指出该版本已在10个月前被弃用，询问使用旧版本的原因。
• [agiron123] 分享个人经历，回忆起大学项目，认为这种项目是学习新语言的好方法，并对项目表示赞赏。

补充讨论：
• [b0a04gl] 对项目的完整性和安全性提出质疑，指出缺乏崩溃恢复、加密握手、uTP支持和NAT处理，认为在实际使用中存在风险，需要模块化和添加内存保护。还提到希望看到项目的路线图。
• [NooneAtAll3] 询问是否支持磁链，并在编辑后提到这是一个计划中的功能。
• [NoMoreNicksLeft] 关注更高级的功能，询问是否实现了BitTorrent v2和可变 torrents，并强烈希望有人实现可变 torrents。
• [TheEdonian] 询问添加图形用户界面（GUI）的难度，表示对GO语言的GUI实现不熟悉。
• [throwaway894345] 对项目的实现难度和完成度表示好奇，询问是否支持DHT和磁链，以及处理各种NAT traversal的协议，并表示对完整功能列表的不确定性。
• [OccamsMirror] 询问项目是否可以作为库使用。
• [tomhow] 表示此评论为题外话。

争议焦点：
• 项目的安全性和功能完整性是主要的讨论焦点。特别是动态分配大小和防DoS攻击的建议，以及对崩溃恢复、加密握手、uTP支持和NAT处理的关注。
• 使用旧版本Go语言的原因也被提出来讨论。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 添加简单使用说明和从URL解析种子的功能建议。
• 对BitTorrent v2和可变 torrents 的高级功能需求。
• 添加GUI的可行性和项目模块化及库使用的可能性。

Go-Torrent
A BitTorrent client implementation in Go that supports downloading files using the BitTorrent protocol. This project implements the core functionality of a BitTorrent client, including torrent file parsing, peer discovery, and file downloading.
Features
Bencode Encoding/Decoding
Support for all Bencode types (strings, integers, lists, dictionaries)
Robust error handling and validation
Torrent File Processing
Parse .torrent files (both single-file and multi-file torrents)
Info hash calculation
Piece hash extraction
Support for all standard torrent file fields
Peer Discovery and Communication
HTTP tracker support
Peer handshake protocol
Complete BitTorrent message protocol
Peer connection management
Download Functionality
Piece and block management
Concurrent downloads
Progress tracking
File assembly for both single and multi-file torrents
Storage management with block-level granularity
Project Structure
.
├── cmd/          # Command-line interface and main application
├── internal/     # Internal packages
│   ├── bencode/  # Bencode encoding/decoding
│   ├── torrent/  # Torrent file processing
│   ├── tracker/  # Tracker protocol implementation
│   ├── peer/     # Peer communication
│   └── download/ # Download management
└── pkg/          # Public packages
Requirements
Go 1.21 or later

data.title: Major sugar substitute found to impair brain blood vessel cell function
data.author: wglb
data.article_summary:
研究发现，常用代糖**赤藓糖醇**可能损害脑血管内皮细胞功能，增加中风风险。美国科罗拉多大学博尔德分校的研究人员通过体外实验发现，赤藓糖醇增加氧化应激，干扰一氧化氮信号，提升血管收缩肽的生产，并降低血凝块溶解能力。具体表现为暴露于赤藓糖醇的细胞中，活性氧水平上升75%，一氧化氮生成减少20%，血栓溶解反应减弱。尽管这些结果基于短期体外实验，但与先前流行病学研究中赤藓糖醇与心血管事件的关联一致。研究人员建议进一步开展长期体内研究，以确认饮食中反复摄入赤藓糖醇是否会对脑血管健康产生影响。

来源: **Phys.org**，2025年6月12日
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于赤藓糖醇（Erythritol）的安全性及其潜在健康影响的讨论，基于一项细胞培养研究。

不同观点：
• **对研究方法的质疑**：一些评论对研究基于体外细胞培养（in vitro）的方法表示怀疑，认为这与人体或动物实验不同，可能无法直接推导出对人体健康的影响。例如，maeln和htx80nerd指出研究是在细胞培养中进行的，且处理时间较短（仅3小时或24小时），这与实际人体摄入情境不同。
